$description: Closed assetRole vocabulary (schema definitions.assetRole). Every media/logo field in a PageSpec carries one of these. generationPolicy values: may-generate-new | reference-existing-only | must-not-generate. generated.ui-illustration (original generated UI illustration) is the only role for media slots off the homepage; its mustNotDepict list is PINNED in verify_all. Roles prefixed home.* carry real Airtable/customer trademarks, likeness or proprietary media and are PINNED (verify_all fails if their policy changes).

generationPolicies.may-generate-new: AI may generate new, original, brand-neutral placeholder content for this role.
generationPolicies.reference-existing-only: Only the existing local file may be referenced (home route only); nothing may be generated, re-encoded or imitated.
generationPolicies.must-not-generate: Never generate, trace, redraw or name; only the existing local file may be shown on the home route.

globalRules: Never generate or reproduce real Airtable logos/wordmarks, real customer or partner logos, photos or likenesses of real people, real product screenshots, or real Airtable marketing copy.

Media slots off the homepage use generated.ui-illustration: original generated illustration only; mustNotDepict (real Airtable logos, real customer/partner logos, real product screenshots, real people, real company/product names) is pinned and machine-checked.
All generated PageSpecs use ORIGINAL placeholder copy within the copy budgets and contentPolicy.copy = 'original-placeholder'.
Person names in quotes/testimonials must be fictional (as in the clone's /platform and /solutions/enterprise stories).
This repository and its assets are for local reference only: do not publish the repo, the clone or its media.

generated.ui-illustration.description: Media slot = the measured placeholder box (ratio from the closed ratio enum; fill #E0E2E6 / #F8F6F6 light, #2A2F38 dark) covered by an ORIGINAL, deterministic, static inline-SVG product-UI scene (<MockMedia>, primitive mock-media, md- CSS prefix). The scene is absolutely positioned (inset 0) so it never changes the slot's layout.
generated.ui-illustration.kindSelection: kind is NOT a PageSpec field. The renderer derives it from the slot's own copy (hint = badge/headline/title) with pickKind's ordered keyword rules, else a seeded rotation over the 8 UI kinds; Season slots mix the route into the seed. Some call sites force a kind in code (story, glyph, ai, hub, gradient/bars). To steer the scene, write the slot's copy; never add a kind/src field.
generated.ui-illustration.aiGuidance: Generate ORIGINAL abstract product-UI illustrations only (generic grid/board/calendar/chart/form/flow vocabulary, generic labels such as 'Launch checklist' or 'Weekly report', fictional data). Never a real Airtable logo/wordmark, never a real customer/partner logo, never a real product screenshot (or a trace/reconstruction of one), never a photo, avatar or likeness of a real person, never a real company or product name. Static only: no motion.
generated.ui-illustration.observedOn: every built route except '/' (the homepage keeps its real media under the pinned home.* roles)
